about: Value investing long, with well-known short positions (not shown in 13F).

checks.msg: 1 holding(s) left out of the copy record because the ticker's price didn't match the price filed (often an old ticker now used by another company): KVUE.

summary: 46 holdings; the top ten are 53% of the portfolio.
Trades a lot: about 67% of the portfolio changes in a year.
The average holding, by value, has been owned for at least 3.8 years.
Copying each filing beat the S&P 500 in 6 of 9 full years.

profile.background: Born in 1968; Cornell. Founded Greenlight Capital in May 1996 with $900,000. Since 2024 Greenlight's holdings are reported under DME Capital Management.
profile.approach: Value-oriented long positions, combined with short selling of companies he believes are overvalued or misreporting.
known: Publicly shorted Allied Capital (2002) and Lehman Brothers (2008, before its collapse).
Averaged 26% a year in its first decade, but lost money from 2014 to 2018.
profile.note: His short positions, an important part of his approach, are not in the 13F.

name: David Einhorn
